title: SHIFT-JEV: Certified Abstention and Gain-Gated Continual Adaptation for LLM-Based Decision Models under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.34329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can act as decision models that return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options, but deployed decision models face domain, label-prior, emerging-class and candidate-set shift. We study how such models fail under shift and propose SHIFT-Jev, a monitoring, abstention and continual-adaptation procedure for them. It scores the risk of each decision from uncertainty, format and option-consistency signals, certifies abstention thresholds with Learn-then-Test, monitors the decision stream with drift and label-shift detectors, and accepts a model update only when an expected-gain gate finds a significant held-out improvement without loss on earlier regimes. On a benchmark of ten shifted test environments with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B (three seeds each) and Phi-4-mini, fine-tuning with KL anchors and temperature scaling lowers calibration error under shift from 0.289 to 0.087. translated_title: SHIFT-JEV：面向分布偏移下基于大语言模型的决策模型的认证弃权与增益门控持续自适应方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以作为决策模型，对固定的选项集合返回一个概率分布，但部署后的决策模型会面临领域偏移、标签先验偏移、新兴类别偏移和候选集偏移。我们研究了此类模型在分布偏移下如何失效，并提出了SHIFT-Jev——一种针对此类模型的监控、弃权与持续自适应流程。该方法从不确定性、格式和选项一致性信号对每个决策进行风险评分，通过"学习后测试"（Learn-then-Test）方法认证弃权阈值，使用漂移检测器和标签偏移检测器监控决策数据流，并且只有当期望增益门控发现模型在留出集上有显著改进且不损害早期任务性能时才接受模型更新。在一个包含十个偏移测试环境的基准上（使用Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-4B各三个随机种子，以及Phi-4-mini），结合KL锚定的微调与温度缩放将分布偏移下的校准误差从0.289降至0.087。在10%的目标风险下，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SHIFT-JEV框架，通过风险评分、认证弃权阈值、漂移监控与期望增益门控更新机制，使基于大语言模型的决策模型在分布偏移下实现安全的持续自适应，将校准误差从0.289降至0.087。
en_tdlr: SHIFT-JEV introduces a monitoring, certified abstention, and gain-gated continual adaptation framework that enables LLM-based decision models to safely adapt under distribution shift, reducing calibration error from 0.289 to 0.087.
